tools.name: workspace.overview
tools.description: The current workspace and the member reading it.

tools.name: workspace.rename
tools.description: Change a workspace's display name.

tools.name: workspace.setState
tools.description: Set the workspace to active, read-only or frozen (TECHNICAL-PLAN §4.1, the freeze overlay).

tools.name: workspace.provision
tools.description: Create a workspace and its first member for a newly registered person.

tools.name: people.updateOwnProfile
tools.description: Update the signed-in member's own timezone, avatar, bio, primary channel or quiet hours.

tools.name: people.updateMember
tools.description: Update another member's name, title or manager (org fields).

tools.name: people.suspend
tools.description: Suspend a member, removing every access they had.

tools.name: people.restore
tools.description: Restore a suspended member's access.

tools.name: people.convertToGuest
tools.description: Convert a member to a guest, stripping their prior bindings.

tools.name: people.erase
tools.description: Anonymise a member: their history stays attributable to a placeholder identity, and their personal data is exported first.

tools.name: people.directory
tools.description: Every active member of the workspace.

tools.name: people.orgChart
tools.description: The manager chain as a tree.

tools.name: people.possibleManagers
tools.description: Every member who could safely become this member's manager.

tools.name: invitations.createWorkspaceLink
tools.description: Create a reusable link anyone holding it may join through.

tools.name: invitations.createPersonalLink
tools.description: Invite one email address, usable once.

tools.name: invitations.revokeLink
tools.description: Revoke a link. Already-used memberships are unaffected.

tools.name: invitations.acceptLink
tools.description: Accept an invite link and join the workspace.

tools.name: invitations.joinByTrustedDomain
tools.description: Join a workspace automatically because your email domain is trusted.

tools.name: channels.listConnections
tools.description: Every channel provider this workspace has connected.

tools.name: channels.connect
tools.description: Stores a provider's credentials and marks it connected.

tools.name: channels.disconnect
tools.description: Removes a provider's connection and its stored credentials.

tools.name: channels.listIdentities
tools.description: The caller's own linked channel identities.

tools.name: channels.linkIdentity
tools.description: Links the caller's own account on a provider.

tools.name: channels.startLink
tools.description: Issues a short code for linking the caller's own account.

tools.name: channels.unlinkIdentity
tools.description: Unlinks the caller's own account on a provider.

tools.name: channels.send
tools.description: Queues one message to a member, at most once per key.

tools.name: channels.listMessages
tools.description: The recent outbound message log, newest first.

tools.name: channels.mySettings
tools.description: The caller's own primary channel, quiet hours and linked accounts.

tools.name: channels.testSend
tools.description: Queues a test message to the caller through the normal path.

tools.name: channels.templates
tools.description: The WhatsApp templates this workspace has at Meta.

tools.name: channels.syncTemplates
tools.description: Records the WhatsApp templates a sync read from Meta.

tools.name: channels.templateMappings
tools.description: Which WhatsApp template each reminder rule uses.

tools.name: channels.saveTemplateMapping
tools.description: Points one reminder rule at one approved WhatsApp template.

tools.name: channels.removeTemplateMapping
tools.description: Forgets which WhatsApp template a reminder rule used.

tools.name: connections.mine
tools.description: The external agents this member connected, newest first.

tools.name: connections.revoke
tools.description: End one of your own connections to an external agent.

tools.name: tokens.mine
tools.description: The signed-in member's own API tokens, newest first.

tools.name: tokens.create
tools.description: Mint an API token, shown once, carrying your own authority.

tools.name: tokens.revoke
tools.description: Revoke one of your own API tokens.

tools.name: tokens.pendingDevice
tools.description: The terminal request one device code names, if it is still open.

tools.name: tokens.approveDevice
tools.description: Approve or deny a terminal that asked to sign in as you.

tools.name: copilot.ask
tools.description: Records a question for the copilot, starting a conversation if this is the first one.

tools.name: copilot.recordAnswer
tools.description: Records the copilot's answer to the last question in a conversation.

tools.name: copilot.thread
tools.description: One copilot conversation, with the citations this reader may see.

tools.name: copilot.threads
tools.description: The reader's own copilot conversations, most recent first.

tools.name: copilot.availability
tools.description: Whether the copilot can answer, and why not when it cannot.

tools.name: copilot.recordProposal
tools.description: Records a proposal the copilot made in a conversation.

tools.name: copilot.proposals
tools.description: The proposals the copilot made in one conversation.

tools.name: copilot.applyProposal
tools.description: Applies one copilot proposal through the normal Operation pipeline.

tools.name: copilot.dismissProposal
tools.description: Dismisses one copilot proposal without applying it.

tools.name: copilot.undoProposal
tools.description: Reverses an applied copilot proposal, where the action has a reverse.

tools.name: blobs.prepareUpload
tools.description: Reserve a storage key for an upload, after validating it.

tools.name: blobs.claimUpload
tools.description: Finalise an upload once the bytes are in storage.

tools.name: blobs.getForDownload
tools.description: Resolve a blob's storage key, after checking access to it.

tools.name: notifications.list
tools.description: The signed-in member's own inbox.

tools.name: notifications.markRead
tools.description: Marks one of the signed-in member's own notifications read.

tools.name: notifications.snooze
tools.description: Hides one of the signed-in member's own notifications until later.

tools.name: notifications.getSettings
tools.description: The signed-in member's own notification settings.

tools.name: notifications.updateSettings
tools.description: Updates the signed-in member's own notification settings.

tools.name: subscriptions.toggle
tools.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes the signed-in member from a subject.

tools.name: activities.workspaceFeed
tools.description: The workspace-scoped activity feed, newest first.

tools.name: settings.readWorkspaceSettings
tools.description: The workspace's own settings map, for the admin cards.

tools.name: settings.updateWorkspaceGeneral
tools.description: Change the workspace's timezone, language or trusted email domains.

tools.name: settings.updateWorkspaceBranding
tools.description: Replace the workspace's branding.

tools.name: settings.resetWorkspaceSettings
tools.description: Reset one workspace setting, or a whole admin card, to its default.

tools.name: ai.readProviderConfig
tools.description: Every provider's admin configuration, with a masked hint for its workspace key.

tools.name: ai.updateProviderConfig
tools.description: Turns a provider on or off for this workspace, and whether members may add a personal key for it.

tools.name: ai.setWorkspaceCredential
tools.description: Sets or replaces the workspace's own key for a provider.

tools.name: ai.removeWorkspaceCredential
tools.description: Removes the workspace's own key for a provider.

tools.name: ai.setPersonalCredential
tools.description: Sets or replaces the signed-in member's own key for a provider.

tools.name: ai.removePersonalCredential
tools.description: Removes the signed-in member's own key for a provider.

tools.name: ai.readOwnCredentialStatus
tools.description: Which providers accept a personal key, and whether the signed-in member has one.

tools.name: ai.rotateCredentials
tools.description: Re-wraps every credential this workspace stores onto the current root key.

tools.name: ai.readModelCatalog
tools.description: The seeded model catalogue plus this workspace's own custom entries.

tools.name: ai.addCustomModel
tools.description: Adds a custom or self-hosted model, with its own context window and cost figures.

tools.name: ai.updateCustomModel
tools.description: Edits a custom model's context window, cost figures or tier tags.

tools.name: ai.removeCustomModel
tools.description: Removes a custom model from the catalogue.

tools.name: ai.readTierRouting
tools.description: Every tier's effective route: an explicit policy, or the seeded default for whatever this workspace has enabled.

tools.name: ai.setTierPolicy
tools.description: Maps a tier to a specific provider, model and sampling settings for this workspace.

tools.name: ai.removeTierPolicy
tools.description: Removes a tier's explicit policy, reverting it to the seeded default.

tools.name: ai.readFeatureSettings
tools.description: Every feature's admin-configured switch and tier override.

tools.name: ai.updateFeatureSetting
tools.description: Turns one AI feature on or off, and optionally pins it to a different tier.

tools.name: ai.readPrompt
tools.description: The current system prompt for a feature or agent phase, and every prior version.

tools.name: ai.updatePrompt
tools.description: Records a new version of a feature or agent phase's system prompt.

tools.name: ai.restorePrompt
tools.description: Removes every stored version for a prompt key, so the built-in default serves again.

tools.name: ai.readBudgets
tools.description: Every configured budget for this workspace, per user, per agent and workspace-wide.

tools.name: ai.setBudget
tools.description: Sets or replaces a budget: per user, per agent or workspace-wide.

tools.name: ai.removeBudget
tools.description: Removes a budget.

tools.name: ai.readUsageSummary
tools.description: Total calls, tokens, cost and flagged calls for this workspace since a given date.

tools.name: agents.list
tools.description: Every agent this workspace has, seeded or custom.

tools.name: agents.create
tools.description: Creates an agent: its own member record, kind = 'agent', with no access until bound.

tools.name: agents.setEnabled
tools.description: Turns an agent on or off.

tools.name: agents.bindScope
tools.description: Grants an agent's member group a binding on one named resource — never workspace-wide.

tools.name: agents.startRun
tools.description: Starts a run for an agent against an already-decomposed task list.

tools.name: agents.readRun
tools.description: One run's status, task progress, cost and its full append-only log.

tools.name: agents.cancelRun
tools.description: Cancels a run that is still planning or running.

tools.name: agents.runChampion
tools.description: Runs the Champion's nudge queue once, recording what fired in its run log.

tools.name: agents.runCoach
tools.description: Runs the Coach's quality pass once, recording what fired in its run log.

tools.name: agents.listRuns
tools.description: Recent agent runs with their logs, newest first.

tools.name: proposals.list
tools.description: Every pending proposal waiting in the review inbox.

tools.name: proposals.bulkApply
tools.description: Applies one or more pending proposals through the normal Operation pipeline, with the deciding member as the actor.

tools.name: proposals.bulkDismiss
tools.description: Dismisses one or more pending proposals without applying them.

tools.name: spaces.list
tools.description: Every space this member can see, with their own role in each.

tools.name: spaces.read
tools.description: One space with its members and who runs its weekly session.

tools.name: spaces.create
tools.description: Creates a space, with an optional first manager.

tools.name: spaces.update
tools.description: Renames a space or rewrites its mission.

tools.name: spaces.archive
tools.description: Archives a space. Its goals and history stay readable.

tools.name: spaces.addMember
tools.description: Adds a member to a space in a role, granting that role's access.

tools.name: spaces.setMemberRole
tools.description: Changes a space member's role, replacing what that role grants.

tools.name: spaces.removeMember
tools.description: Removes a member from a space and takes back its access.

tools.name: spaces.join
tools.description: Joins a space as an ordinary member.

tools.name: spaces.leave
tools.description: Leaves a space. The space stays visible and rejoinable.

tools.name: cycles.list
tools.description: Every cycle this workspace has, newest first.

tools.name: cycles.current
tools.description: The cycle to show: the one containing today, else the soonest ahead, else the most recent behind.

tools.name: cycles.ensureCurrent
tools.description: Creates the cycle containing today if the workspace has none. Idempotent.

tools.name: cycles.create
tools.description: Creates a named cycle for the period containing a chosen date.

tools.name: cycles.update
tools.description: Sets a cycle's roles, phase, levels, session dates or publication deadline.

tools.name: cycles.archive
tools.description: Archives a cycle. Its goals and scores stay readable.

tools.name: cycles.snapshot
tools.description: Records what a cycle achieved: the result, the band counts and the portfolio verdict, one snapshot per owner.

tools.name: cycles.feedForward
tools.description: Hands METHOD.md §8.9's inheritance to the next cycle: prior scores, carried work as issues at impact four, and the annual frame.

tools.name: cycles.scorecard
tools.description: Every archived cycle's result with its band counts and verdict, oldest first. Drives the scorecard.

tools.name: rhythm.read
tools.description: The METHOD.md §11 registry as this workspace resolves it, with its deviations and its terminology.

tools.name: rhythm.update
tools.description: Changes this workspace's deviations from the §11 canon, or its terminology.

tools.name: frame.read
tools.description: The current annual frame and its strategic thrusts.

tools.name: frame.set
tools.description: Creates or replaces the current annual frame. A replacement supersedes rather than edits.

tools.name: workflow.read
tools.description: A cycle's phase completion, its six publish gates and the rows they are computed from.

tools.name: workflow.setPackItem
tools.description: Marks one of the seven §2.6 input-pack items gathered, with a note.

tools.name: workflow.distributePack
tools.description: Records that the input pack reached people, which the §2.6 lead time is measured from.

tools.name: workflow.addIssue
tools.description: Adds a ranked strategic issue to a cycle's phase 2 list.

tools.name: workflow.setIssueImpact
tools.description: Reranks a strategic issue. The list is ordered by impact.

tools.name: workflow.addPriority
tools.description: Adds a phase 3 priority, optionally promoting the issue it came from.

tools.name: workflow.setRevalidation
tools.description: Records the quarterly revalidation: the frame holds, or changed with a note.

tools.name: workflow.setBaselineHealth
tools.description: Records phase 2's KPI reading in the three §8.5 columns: stable, declining, business as usual.

tools.name: workflow.setCapacityNotes
tools.description: Records what was cut, which publish gate 5 reads (§5.5: if nothing was cut, capacity was not checked).

tools.name: workflow.calibrate
tools.description: Records the one mid-cycle calibration a cycle is allowed (METHOD.md §7.6).

tools.name: workflow.publish
tools.description: Publishes the set, refusing while any of the six gates is red or cannot be evaluated.

tools.name: documents.list
tools.description: The documents on one subject. Somebody else's draft is not among them.

tools.name: documents.read
tools.description: One document with its body and its version list. Drives screen S-29.

tools.name: documents.difference
tools.description: What changed between two published versions of a document, line by line.

tools.name: documents.create
tools.description: Starts a document on a subject. It is a draft, and a draft is private to its author.

tools.name: documents.update
tools.description: Edits a document. Editing a published one changes it without publishing a version.

tools.name: documents.publish
tools.description: Publishes a document, writing a version and telling the subject's watchers.

tools.name: documents.delete
tools.description: Soft-deletes a document and the versions under it.

tools.name: attachments.list
tools.description: The files attached to one subject.

tools.name: attachments.attach
tools.description: Hangs an uploaded file on a subject.

tools.name: attachments.detach
tools.description: Takes a file off a subject. The file itself is untouched.

tools.name: tasks.board
tools.description: One board: every task in a space, an initiative or a key result, grouped by status. Drives screen S-27.

tools.name: tasks.list
tools.description: Tasks, optionally only the caller's own or only the ones due by a date.

tools.name: tasks.read
tools.description: One task with its assignees and its checklist. Drives screen S-28.

tools.name: tasks.create
tools.description: Creates a task in a space, optionally behind a key result.

tools.name: tasks.update
tools.description: Updates a task's own fields. Its position is moved with tasks.move, not here.

tools.name: tasks.move
tools.description: Moves a card to a column and a slot, under a lock so two drags cannot lose one.

tools.name: tasks.assign
tools.description: Assigns a member, which grants them edit on this task and notifies them.

tools.name: tasks.unassign
tools.description: Removes an assignment and the edit access it granted.

tools.name: tasks.addChecklistItem
tools.description: Adds one line to a task's checklist.

tools.name: tasks.setChecklistItem
tools.description: Ticks or unticks one checklist line.

tools.name: tasks.removeChecklistItem
tools.description: Removes one checklist line.

tools.name: tasks.delete
tools.description: Soft-deletes a task, its assignments and its checklist.

tools.name: tasks.linkedWork
tools.description: Linked work per key result for one cycle: two counts, and the sentence when they disagree with the measure.

tools.name: initiatives.list
tools.description: Initiatives in a space, or the ones serving one key result. Drives screen S-26.

tools.name: initiatives.read
tools.description: One initiative with the key results it serves.

tools.name: initiatives.create
tools.description: Creates an initiative in a space, owned by one member.

tools.name: initiatives.update
tools.description: Updates an initiative's own fields. Progress is derived from its tasks and is not one of them.

tools.name: initiatives.delete
tools.description: Soft-deletes an initiative and the links it held.

tools.name: initiatives.linkKeyResult
tools.description: Records that this initiative is one of the ones that will move a key result (METHOD.md §5.5).

tools.name: initiatives.unlinkKeyResult
tools.description: Removes the link between an initiative and a key result.

tools.name: initiatives.capacity
tools.description: One cycle's capacity check: every key result's verdict and every initiative behind it (METHOD.md §5.5).

tools.name: goals.list
tools.description: Goals in a cycle, or the whole workspace, with their key results attached.

tools.name: goals.read
tools.description: One goal with its key results and its retrospective, if it has one.

tools.name: goals.create
tools.description: Creates a goal with its champion, its reviewer and its access context.

tools.name: goals.update
tools.description: Edits a goal's own fields, including its alignment pointer.

tools.name: goals.close
tools.description: Closes a goal with an outcome, a keep/modify/abandon decision and a retrospective.

tools.name: goals.delete
tools.description: Removes a goal and its key results, which is not the same as closing one.

tools.name: goals.reviewDecision
tools.description: The keep/modify/abandon decision the last quarterly review reached for this goal.

tools.name: goals.reopen
tools.description: Reopens a closed goal, clearing its outcome and keeping its retrospective.

tools.name: goals.reassignRole
tools.description: Moves the champion or the reviewer to another member, rebinding access with it.

tools.name: goals.moveToCycle
tools.description: Moves a goal into another cycle, taking its check-in history with it.

tools.name: goals.addKeyResult
tools.description: Adds a key result to a goal, with its baseline recorded as history.

tools.name: goals.updateKeyResult
tools.description: Edits a key result's definition. The current value has its own action, because it is history.

tools.name: goals.recordValue
tools.description: Moves a key result's value and records the movement as history.

tools.name: goals.unlinkKpi
tools.description: Unlinks a KPI, keeping the value it last reported as a manual one.

tools.name: goals.keyResultHistory
tools.description: One key result's value history, newest first. Drives the sparkline.

tools.name: goals.due
tools.description: The goals this member champions that are due a check-in, soonest first. Drives the session walker.

tools.name: goals.checkIns
tools.description: One goal's check-in timeline, newest first, with each one's snapshot differences.

tools.name: goals.rewriteKeyResult
tools.description: Suggests a corrected key result for one failing check, and reports which checks the suggestion actually passes.

tools.name: goals.draftObjective
tools.description: Drafts an objective and its key results from a plain-language ambition, with the quality checks it passes.

tools.name: goals.suggestMeasure
tools.description: Suggests a unit, a direction, a baseline and a target for a key result, with the checks they pass.

tools.name: goals.suggestParent
tools.description: Suggests which objective this one should align to, from the ones the reader may see.

tools.name: goals.parseFilter
tools.description: Turns a sentence into a validated goals filter, or refuses it with the reason.

tools.name: goals.startCheckIn
tools.description: Opens or reopens the author's draft check-in on a goal. Completely silent.

tools.name: goals.publishCheckIn
tools.description: Publishes a check-in: snapshot, value history, cadence, and the reviewer's obligation.

tools.name: goals.publishDraftedCheckIn
tools.description: Opens the author's draft check-in on a goal and publishes it in one action, for a proposal a human applies.

tools.name: goals.editCheckIn
tools.description: Edits a published check-in inside its window, writing a new snapshot rather than rewriting the old one.

tools.name: goals.deleteCheckIn
tools.description: Deletes a check-in, rolling the goal's pointers and values back when it was the latest.

tools.name: goals.acknowledgeCheckIn
tools.description: The reviewer of record closes the loop. Nobody else can.

tools.name: goals.vote
tools.description: A private confidence vote on one key result. Readable only by its author until the reveal.

tools.name: goals.revealVotes
tools.description: Reveals every vote on a key result in one write, so no client sees a partial reveal.

tools.name: goals.readVotes
tools.description: The votes on one key result: only your own until the reveal, all of them and the average after it.

tools.name: goals.addDependency
tools.description: Links two goals as depending on each other. Stored once; direction carries no meaning.

tools.name: goals.removeDependency
tools.description: Removes a horizontal link between two goals.

tools.name: goals.addKeyResultDependency
tools.description: Records a key result's dependency on a providing team, for the register (METHOD.md §5.4).

tools.name: goals.confirmDependency
tools.description: The providing team confirms a dependency. Only they can, and it clears publish gate 4.

tools.name: goals.setDependencyRiskOwner
tools.description: Names who carries the risk of an unconfirmed dependency. Clears publish gate 4 without claiming a confirmation.

tools.name: goals.removeKeyResultDependency
tools.description: Removes an entry from the dependency register.

tools.name: alignment.read
tools.description: The alignment health score for one cycle, with every open finding and the goal each one opens.

tools.name: alignment.graph
tools.description: The cascade as nodes and edges, for the alignment studio canvas (S-16).

tools.name: goals.relations
tools.description: The parent, children, horizontal dependencies and register entries of one goal.

tools.name: kpis.createCategory
tools.description: Adds a KPI category, which is how the grid groups its rows.

tools.name: kpis.create
tools.description: Adds a KPI with its frequency, unit, direction, tier and corridor thresholds.

tools.name: kpis.record
tools.description: Records a value for the period a date falls in. Re-recording updates rather than duplicating.

tools.name: kpis.grid
tools.description: Every KPI with its recent periods, grouped by category. Drives screen S-20.

tools.name: kpis.setFormula
tools.description: Makes a KPI calculated from a formula over other KPIs, refusing self-reference and cycles.

tools.name: kpis.createTree
tools.description: Names a driver tree. The parent pointers shape it; this row is the tree itself.

tools.name: kpis.launchRecovery
tools.description: Creates METHOD.md §6.5's recovery objective from the leading drivers under an unhealthy KPI.

tools.name: kpis.recoveryDraft
tools.description: The recovery objective a KPI would get, so it can be read before it is committed to.

tools.name: kpis.recoveryBoard
tools.description: Every unhealthy or recovering KPI across every tree, with its recovery objective. Drives screen S-19.

tools.name: kpis.tree
tools.description: One driver tree as nodes with their corridor state and recovery progress. Drives screen S-18.

tools.name: kpis.detail
tools.description: One KPI with its periods, its place in the tree and its formula. Drives screen S-21.

tools.name: kpis.update
tools.description: Edits a KPI's own fields, where it hangs in the tree, and which tree it belongs to.

tools.name: alignment.dismissFinding
tools.description: Dismisses a finding. It stays dismissed while the condition is unchanged.

tools.name: alignment.applyFinding
tools.description: Applies a relink finding by re-parenting the goal through the normal update path.

tools.name: review.inbox
tools.description: What this member owes right now, overdue first. Drives screen S-02 and the sidebar badge.

tools.name: comments.list
tools.description: List comments on a subject

tools.name: comments.create
tools.description: Post a comment on a goal, key result, check-in, cycle or document

tools.name: comments.update
tools.description: Edit a comment (author only)

tools.name: comments.delete
tools.description: Delete a comment (author or moderator with edit access)

tools.name: comments.previewNotify
tools.description: Preview who would be notified by a comment with this body on this subject

tools.name: nudges.run
tools.description: Computes what is due for every member, records a nudge row for each, and delivers what is due to the inbox and the member's own channel.

tools.name: nudges.list
tools.description: This member's nudges, newest first, with the rule that caused each one.

tools.name: nudges.snooze
tools.description: Silences nudges about one subject for this member until a time they choose. Never silences the obligation itself.

tools.name: nudges.volume
tools.description: How many nudges each rule produced over a window, and how many were suppressed and why.

tools.name: reactions.list
tools.description: List reactions on a subject, grouped by emoji

tools.name: reactions.add
tools.description: Add a reaction to any subject

tools.name: reactions.remove
tools.description: Remove your own reaction

tools.name: sessions.create
tools.description: Creates a scheduled session for a space.

tools.name: sessions.open
tools.description: Opens a scheduled session, setting it to running and starting the first stage.

tools.name: sessions.advanceStage
tools.description: Advances a running session to its next stage, recording elapsed time.

tools.name: sessions.skip
tools.description: Marks a scheduled session as skipped.

tools.name: sessions.close
tools.description: Closes a running session.

tools.name: sessions.read
tools.description: One session by id. Returns not-found when the caller lacks access.

tools.name: sessions.list
tools.description: Sessions for a space, newest first.

tools.name: sessions.mine
tools.description: Sessions in every space this member can read, running first.

tools.name: sessions.participants
tools.description: Active space members for a session's space.

tools.name: sessions.castVote
tools.description: A private confidence vote on one key result within a session. Upserts: a second vote replaces the first.

tools.name: sessions.revealVotes
tools.description: Reveals every vote on a key result in one session, atomically.

tools.name: sessions.confirmConfidence
tools.description: The champion confirms the final confidence and writes the what-changed note.

tools.name: sessions.votes
tools.description: Votes for one KR in a session. Before reveal: own vote only. After reveal: all.

tools.name: sessions.confidenceStatus
tools.description: Which KRs are confirmed vs unconfirmed in this session.

tools.name: sessions.createBlocker
tools.description: Opens a blocker for a low-confidence KR during the diagnose step. The 24-hour clock starts on save.

tools.name: sessions.resolveBlocker
tools.description: Marks a blocker as resolved.

tools.name: sessions.reassignBlocker
tools.description: Moves a blocker to a different owner.

tools.name: sessions.blockerStatus
tools.description: Blockers for a session, with aging information.

tools.name: blockers.board
tools.description: Every open blocker in a space, ranked by escalation, then by what it blocks, then by age.

tools.name: blockers.summarise
tools.description: Summarises a space's open blockers, over the product's own ranking, refusing a summary that names one not on the board.

tools.name: sessions.setCommitments
tools.description: Sets this week's commitments (2-3 actions, each with owner and optional KR link).

tools.name: sessions.closeCommitments
tools.description: Closes last week's commitments with a delivered/not-delivered verdict.

tools.name: sessions.listCommitments
tools.description: Commitments for a session.

tools.name: sessions.setCoordinatorNote
tools.description: Adds the coordinator's note to the session digest.

tools.name: sessions.readStreak
tools.description: The rhythm streak for a space.

tools.name: sessions.digest
